import "join"
valores = from(bucket: "static_db_final")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${deviceName}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: string(v: r._value) }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["power-supply"] != "")
  |> group(columns:["power-supply","name"])
  //|> last()
  |> keep(columns:["power-supply","_field","_value","name","_time"])
  |> group()

tiempo = from(bucket: "static_db_final")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${deviceName}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: string(v: r._value) }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["power-supply"] != "")
  |> group(columns:["power-supply","name"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns:["_time"])

join.time(method:"left",left: tiempo, right: valores, as: (l, r) => ({r with timepo: l._time}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "typical-power" or r["_field"] == "nominal-power" or r["_field"] == "capacity")
  |> unique()
  |> rename(columns:{_field:"parameters","power-supply":"type"})
  |> keep(columns:["parameters","type","name","_value"])
